decisions.decision: Unit granularity is Workflow step: Plan, Execute, Verify, Closeout, and settings-gated workflow steps are modeled as explicit units rather than agent-turn units.

Optional gates and pipeline shape must reference /gsd-settings and .planning/config.json workflow toggles; exact precedence between settings, roadmap indicators, and user confirmation is not fully locked yet and should be revisited in planning.

If a Unit fails, Phase 9 should use existing settings-driven retry/repair controls first, especially workflow.node_repair and workflow.node_repair_budget, then pause/escalate when the budget is exhausted or behavior is ambiguous.

discussion_log.question: Phase 9 first native orchestrator coverage
discussion_log.answer: Reference /gsd-settings and all global/project settings, not just phase flags. Need thoroughly inspect settings and relevant parameters.

discussion_log.question: Optional gates behavior
discussion_log.answer: Reference settings; if unclear use AskUserQuestion to confirm; original version likely has this behavior.
